review.feedback: Blocking authorization gap: authorize() checks workflow ownership only when arguments contain workflowId. Calls such as get_execution with an arbitrary executionId pass authorization without establishing project ownership, including at claim_operation(). This violates 3B1’s project-scoped exact authorization contract. Enforce ownership for resource-specific reads and reject calls whose scope cannot be verified; add coverage for foreign execution IDs and omitted scope. Deferred workflow-definition and publication gates are not defects in this increment.
